name: Debian kernel: known vulnerabilities
description: What the Debian security tracker says of the source packages of this rule: the critical and high CVEs that a supported release has not fixed, and the ones it fixed lately. Judged one CVE at a time (installed < fixed), the changelog of the package counts as a fix; 1 CVEs of 1 source packages.
remediation: Update the package: sudo apt update && sudo apt full-upgrade (then sudo apt autoremove --purge removes the old kernels).
